name: CORTEX-RAN
full_name: Cognitive Orchestration, Reasoning & Telemetry-driven EXecution for AI-native RAN
tagline: An AI-native RAN control platform, from network intent to radio execution

acronym.meaning: Understanding what the operator wants: natural-language intents are interpreted and reasoned about with LLMs.
Coordinating RAN resources, services and the control applications that act on them.
Learning-based decision making, e.g. deep reinforcement learning, that turns goals into control actions.
Measuring the RAN — KPM and MAC/RLC/PDCP statistics — so every decision is grounded in live state.
Carrying decisions out in the RAN: scheduling, slice/PRB control and radio actions inside the gNB.
The open interfaces that connect it all: E2, A1, O1 and dApp APIs.

platforms.name: OpenAirInterface
platforms.desc: 5G NR gNB / nrUE (rfsim and USRP), FlexRIC nearRT-RIC, E2SM-KPM / RC

platforms.name: ns-3
platforms.desc: ns-3 network simulator with FlexRIC (O-RAN E2 in simulation)

papers.title: LLM-hRIC: LLM-empowered Hierarchical RAN Intelligent Control for O-RAN
papers.authors: L. Bao, S. Yun, J. Lee, and T. Q. S. Quek
